title: Static Incubation of Pancreatic Islets
author: Islet and Pancreas Analysis Core
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2kfqctn

steps.title: Prepare RPMI with 5.6 mM glucose
steps.instruction: Prepare cell culture media by modifying RPMI.

substeps.instruction: Remove 5 mL from a 500 mL bottle of RPMI and add 5 mL penicillin/streptomycin; invert to mix.
Add 0.505 g glucose to RPMI, invert to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 01:00:00.
Vacuum filter 450 mL of the RPMI in a BSL-2 culture hood.
Add 50 mL FBS.
Store at 4 °C for up to 1 month if not used immediately.

steps.title: Prepare DMEM base media
steps.instruction: Prepare the static incubation media base in a 1 L Erlenmeyer flask.

substeps.instruction: Add 8.28 g DMEM, 3.2 g sodium bicarbonate, 0.58 g L-glutamine, 1.11 g HEPES, 0.11 g sodium pyruvate, 1 g bovine serum albumin, 70 mg ascorbate, and 1 L deionized water.
Add a stir bar and stir on a magnetic stir plate at medium-high speed for 00:15:00.

steps.title: Prepare glucose-specific DMEM solutions
steps.instruction: Create 5.6 mM and 16.7 mM glucose DMEM solutions from the base media.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 500 mL of prepared DMEM media into two separate plastic storage bottles.
For 5.6 mM glucose: Add 0.505 g glucose to one 500 mL aliquot, incubate for 01:00:00, and vacuum-filter.
For 16.7 mM glucose: Add 1.504 g glucose to the other 500 mL aliquot, incubate for 01:00:00, and vacuum-filter.

steps.title: Prepare acid ethanol
steps.instruction: Prepare the solution for hormone extraction.

substeps.instruction: Pipet 5.5 mL 95% ethanol into a 15 mL conical tube.
Add 50 µL hydrochloric acid and invert to mix.

steps.title: Perform overnight islet incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare islets for the experiment using RPMI.

substeps.instruction: Pipet 5 mL RPMI with 5.6 mM glucose into two 6-cm cell culture dishes.
Using an electronic pipette and an inverted microscope, pass islets into the first plate and then into the second.
Place islets in a 37 °C incubator with 5% CO2 for a minimum of 18:00:00 (overnight).

steps.title: Transfer islets to DMEM
steps.instruction: Move islets from the overnight incubation to DMEM media.

substeps.instruction: Pipet 5 mL of DMEM with 5.6 mM glucose into a 6-cm cell culture dish.
Using an electronic pipette and an inverted microscope, transfer islets from the overnight incubation plates into the 6-cm DMEM plate.

steps.title: Set up static incubation plate
steps.instruction: Prepare a 12-well plate for glucose conditions.

substeps.instruction: Label a 12-well plate according to experimental design (e.g., low glucose 5.6 mM and high glucose 16.7 mM).
Pipet 2 mL of the appropriate media into each well, ensuring each condition has a 'wash' well and an 'incubation' well.

steps.title: Aliquot islets into wells
steps.instruction: Distribute islets into the wash wells of the 12-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Under microscope guidance, place approximately 20 islet equivalents (IEQs) into each wash well (typically 12 small, 5 medium, and 2 large islets).

steps.title: Transfer islets to incubation wells
steps.instruction: Move islets from wash wells to incubation wells.

substeps.instruction: Place the plate on a stereomicroscope stage and swirl to center the islets in each well.
Transfer islets into the subsequent incubation wells using no more than 20 µL of media to avoid dilution.

steps.title: Incubate and cool islets
steps.instruction: Perform the timed incubation and cooling phase.

substeps.instruction: Cover the plate and place in a 37 °C incubator with 5% CO2 for 01:10:00 (10 min warm-up + 1 hour incubation).
Remove the plate and place on ice for 00:10:00 to cool down.
Label two 2-mL microcentrifuge tubes for each incubation well: one for islet extract and one for media.

steps.title: Collect media and islets
steps.instruction: Separate the media and the islet pellets.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 1.5 mL media from each incubation well into the designated media microcentrifuge tube and store at -20 °C.
Return the plate to the stereomicroscope stage, swirl to center the islets, and pipet the islets from each incubation well into the designated islet extract microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Extract hormones from islets
steps.instruction: Process islet pellets for hormone extraction.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the islet tubes for 00:03:00 at 200 rcf.
Remove the supernatant from the islet pellets.
Add 200 µL acid ethanol to each tube.
Transfer islet extract tubes to 4 °C and incubate for 24:00:00.
Spin down islet extract tubes for 00:05:00 at 3000 rcf.
Transfer three 50-µL supernatant aliquots from each islet extract tube into prelabeled 2-mL screwcap tubes and store at -80 °C.
Perform the chosen hormone assay.
